verdict.rationale: Ramp's open-source CLI is explicitly built for headless automation. It has `--agent` JSON output (the default when piped), `--no-input` to disable prompts for CI, and browserless OAuth client-credentials login via RAMP_CLIENT_ID/RAMP_CLIENT_SECRET. RAMP_PROFILE "pins an identity for automation," and the docs name "scripted/scheduled workflows" as a CLI use case. Server-to-server client-credentials API access, webhooks, a sandbox the CLI defaults to, and a live OpenAPI spec round out the automation surface. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI running in a real CI pipeline, and documented CI-specific examples such as a GitHub Actions setup.
